summary.LABEL: MODEL_FREE_CEILING
summary.method: No-chase discipline, model-free replay over all 804. One coherent state per leg per book receipt from BOTH evidence types: (a) quote-path new-low-ask/seller-hit=FALLING, new-high-bid/buyer-lift=RISING, else SETTLED (trailing 300s); (b) depth-pressure depth_ratio>=0.60 RISING / <=0.40 FALLING / else SETTLED. Disagreement (a vs b opposite) logged. DISCIPLINE: never lift a FALLING ask; while FALLING rest a maker bid 1c under best (seller-hits fill us at the certified maker floor); when SETTLED the standing ask is takeable; either fill arms the other at cap 99-fill; no clock, carry to bell. Fill model: FALLING leg -> maker fill at certified maker_floor (residency); else lowest SETTLED ask -> taker; else ran-away miss. THIS IS A CEILING, NOT AN EXECUTABLE SCORE.

cost_column.note: certified-winnable games the no-chase discipline LOST (leg ran away / never settled low) -- the honest demote-risk
